test_title: PYST 73: SSC CGL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: The volume of a right circular cylindrical box of radius 30cm is 600cm3. Find the height of the box. ( π = 3.14 )
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of a cylinder = π × r² × h

h = V ÷ (π × r²)

h = 600 ÷ (3.14 × 30²)

h = 600 ÷ 2826

h ≈ 0.21 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 0.21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the cylinder (r) = 30 cm

Volume of the cylinder (V) = 600 cm³

Value of π = 3.14

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a right circular cylinder = π × r² × h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7603e4a567d836b50c6dcfec36e36c9ce9eacd055070b08cb42276e35b5d11d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ V = π × r² × h

⇒ 600 = 3.14 × (30)² × h

⇒ 600 = 3.14 × 900 × h

⇒ 600 = 2826 × h

⇒ h = 600 ÷ 2826

⇒ h ≈ 0.2123 cm

⇒ h ≈ 0.21 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 0.21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area of a Cylinder

The curved surface area (CSA) of a right circular cylinder is given by 2 × π × r × h.

Total Surface Area of a Cylinder

The total surface area (TSA) includes the CSA and the area of the two circular bases, given by 2 × π × r × (r + h).

Volume of a Cone

A cone with the same base radius and height as a cylinder has exactly one-third of the cylinder's volume, given by (1 ÷ 3) × π × r² × h.
